description_en: Retrieves the dashboard information of an application for each service
description_zh: 获取应用在各服务下的看板信息
kebab_example: aliyun mhub describe-dashboard --service-name mqc --app-key 29201799 --app-type 1 --app-version 4.8 --keyword deprecated --start-time 1681369984564 --end-time 1681985390256 --proxy-action queryAppVersions --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDashboard

parameters.help_en: The AppKey of the application, which uniquely identifies the application
parameters.help_zh: 指定应用的appkey，唯一标识应用
parameters.name: app_key

parameters.help_en:
The application type. Valid values:
1: iOS
2: Android
8: MoPen web client
9: MoPen mobile client
parameters.help_zh: 应用类型，取值如下：1：ios2：android8：魔笔网页端9：魔笔移动端
parameters.name: app_type

parameters.help_en: The application version. Default value: the latest version
parameters.help_zh: 应用版本，默认为最新版
parameters.name: app_version

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，精确到毫秒的unix时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: This parameter takes effect only when ServiceName is set to apm. The sub-query type, such as querying app versions, querying performance monitoring overview, or querying crash overview
parameters.help_zh: 仅serviceName为 apm 时生效，子查询：查询app版本、查询性能监控概览，查询崩溃概览
parameters.name: proxy_action

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求唯一标识，用于识别一个请求
